fields.description: Master kill switch for referral reward payouts. When unchecked, NO referral rewards are paid: payouts triggered by an invitee's KYC approval are DEFERRED (the invite stays unrewarded and can be paid later after re-enabling), never lost and never marked failed. Invites, signups, and KYC itself are unaffected. Flash re-reads this within ~60 seconds of a change.
fields.label: Rewards Payouts Enabled
